args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

• Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb, so the account now appears under the new name.
• Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That report is probably still using the old label.
• Please check whether the saved report needs updating so the old name doesn't show up in the digest or in account reporting.
• The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
• The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti (sent via Bettina Kroll's request)
